newsitem.title: USA: Quad says may be hurt by Centennial Tech.
newsitem.headline: Quad says may be hurt by Centennial Tech.

text.p: Quad Systems Corp said Wednesday its fiscal second-quarter earnings would be hurt and it might be in credit default if it cannot collect about $750,000 owed to it by Centennial Technologies Inc.
Quad, a semiconductor equipment maker based here, said it was unsure whether it would be able to collect the accounts receivable from Centennial.
Centennial said Tuesday it expected to restate its financial statements for fiscal 1996 and the first two quarters of fiscal 1997 and would have losses for all three periods.

Centennial, whose former chief executive is being held by police on insider trading and other charges, faces a slew of lawsuits alleging it overstated its financial results during parts of 1996 and 1997. The company's shares have fallen from 58-1/4 earlier in the year to 2-1/4 in afternoon trading today.
Quad said uncertainty about whether it will receive the payments from Centennial was being further fueled by Centennial's statement about expected losses.
Quad said it is not yet in default, has notified its lenders of the situation, and is working with them to obtain waivers to any defaults.

Dominique Badel, a Quad spokeswoman, said, "If you read (Centennial's) press release, they did say they will restate their results and that they will have a loss, but we don't know if it will be a significant loss or even if they will be able to stay in business.
"Or they may be able to pay and we'll collect it all. The only thing we're going by is Centennial's press releases."
Officials from Centennial were not available for comment.
